note: Round ADDIN (R301, Q044). The IM code each neighbourhood is known by in the file names of each job, one table per job, since the letters name other areas in the two jobs: the Native IMA holds 02 and 01A, the Parsons site models of Revit All Zones name IMA and IMB Zone 1. The area of a plot is always its Neighbourhood_ID and Construction_Zone of the Rev 9 DLUS (R256), never an IM letter, so this file only names files. Every row is measured: the plots a file of that job holds, keyed by the area key, with the file, its kind (model or schedule), the count and where the count was measured. No row is guessed, the four rows DATA-5 guessed by the letter order (IMA 021, IMB 022, IME 02, IMF 03) are gone. native comes from the Round 17 coverage (R267): key plots of the location plan unit plots of each neighbourhood. parsons holds only what was measured on a Parsons file and is filled from the 7 Parsons site models in Phase 2 of Round ADDIN. The Rev.09 location plan title of Zone 4 names 01101-PSN-IMG-ZZZ-PIM-TU-000001 (DATA-5) but gives no count, so IMG has no row yet.
